thread:
maya: Quick sync — customer X is pushing for a formal 'burst entitlement' that guarantees a minimum burst capacity + SLOs for Dedicated. Need a short playbook, launch gates, and who owns the contract tradeoffs. cc @sam @ezra

sam: Ok — can you share the asks? how big/for how long?

maya: They've asked for a 4x capacity burst for up to 15m per day per reservation, with p95 latency target at <200ms during burst. Want a formal SLA (financial) and an operational playbook.

olivia: From CS: several large customers are escalating. They want clarity on when we'll honor bursts vs when we'll throttle. Also want observability: dashboard + post-burst report.

ezra: Technical constraints: our current allocator supports soft-preempt but not guaranteed instantaneous 4x. Fast path would need pre-reserved 'burst pockets' or borrowing credits model. Either approach affects utilization.

sam: Notes on options: 1) Dedicated burst pockets: carve N GPUs per region for bursts (simple, predictable cost). 2) Credit-based borrow: customers accumulate credits and we preempt lower-tier tenants (complex scheduling). 3) Hybrid: small reserved slice + credits for bigger spikes.

jordan: Pricing implications: pockets = higher baseline cost for customer; credits = usage-based, easier to monetize but harder to guarantee latency. We should map to 3 commercial tiers.

maya: Launch gates proposal: must have (a) allocator behavior defined, (b) billing model agreed, (c) observability + post-burst reporting, (d) failover/fallback policy (auto-route to hosted model variant).

ezra: Implementation rough estimate: pockets -> ~3 sprints (allocator + eviction rules + accounting). credits -> 4-6 sprints (scheduling + fairness + billing integration). Need to decide ASAP for Q3 target.

olivia: Customer acceptance criteria suggested: documented SLA, test plan that simulates bursts, WAFU (who does what) runbook, and an opt-in pilot with 2 customers.

sam: For tests I can sketch a load harness: `k6` + synthetic clients -> ramp to 4x sustained for 15m and measure p95/p99. Also need gating thresholds for slow-start vs immediate ramp.

maya: Decision needed this week: pockets vs credits. If pockets, we can pilot earlier but cost teams will need pricing. If credits, we get flexible monetization but later delivery.

jordan: I'll model three pricing rows and share by EOD today.

ezra: Also: we need to lock how eviction works for soft preempt: `soft-preempt` should degrade best-effort workloads first. I'll add proposed priority list to the doc.

maya: Action items: @jordan pricing model, @sam test harness + perf criteria, @ezra allocation design + eviction rules, @olivia pilot customers + acceptance plan. I'll own the playbook doc and launch gate checklist.

capacity-bot: Deploy status: branch `burst-pocket-prototype` CI passing. 1/3 integration tests failing (allocator timeouts).

sam: saw the CI failures, will triage this afternoon.

maya: Thanks — let's reconvene tomorrow 10am PT for decision. If anyone can't, drop comments in the doc: https://redwood.atlassian.com/dedicated/burst-playbook (draft). :thumbsup:

jordan: ACK

olivia: ACK

ezra: ACK

sam: ACK

maya: End of thread.
